question: Which article of Indian Constitution says, 'The state shall take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the state'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 50.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Article 50: According to this Article the State shall take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive.
